Plugin.Name: Unraid Management Agent
Plugin.Description: Monitor and control your Unraid system via REST API, WebSocket, MCP, Prometheus, and MQTT. Supports Docker/VM control, real-time metrics, Home Assistant integration, and AI agent tooling.
